Crafting Materials
==================

Crafting materials are used for various enhancements, such as upgrading gear, [moving mods](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
, and rerolling stats.  
The following materials are used to upgrade gear. Plain materials are found in [C1-C3](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Chaos "Chaos")
, Shiny materials are found in [C4-C6](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Chaos "Chaos")
, Pristine materials are found in [C7-C9](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Chaos "Chaos")
, and Exquisite Materials are found in [C10](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Chaos "Chaos")
.

  

Ampoules
--------
